messages:
maria.ops: FYI - SCIM syncs failing for a subset of tenants after last-night mapping tweak. Provisioner returning 403; KMS logs show DecryptError.
trent: Which mapping change landed?
maria.ops: We switched extId construction in the idp: previously `tenant + '/' + uid`, now `tenant + ':' + uid` to match new internal IDs.
kevin.ids: That will break the KMS metadata lookup. Table keys are stored with the slash. If lookup misses, provisioner tries decrypt with empty ref -> invalid_ciphertext/DecryptError.
kms-guardian: Error sample: `provisioner ERROR: DecryptFailed user=svc-scim x-request-id=abc123 err="invalid_ciphertext (empty key_ref)"`
trent: Quick fixes: 1) revert idp mapping, 2) make provisioner accept both separators for 48h, 3) backfill metadata entries for new format. Revert is risky mid-day.
maria.ops: We'll deploy a tolerant patch to provisioner (accept both) as a canary, and run a controlled backfill copying metadata from `tenant/uid` -> `tenant:uid` with audit tags.
kevin.ids: Important: tag backfilled rows with source_audit_id and make operation idempotent. Also avoid rewrapping envelopes unless necessary.
pager-team: I'll mute the SCIM KMS alert group for 90 minutes while you run canary.
maria.ops: Canary passed on staging (50 users). Starting prod backfill at low rate. Monitoring dashboards and audit stream.
trent: Follow-ups: add a contract test between idp mapping and provisioner, add a KMS-key-ref sanity check early in provisioner, and update the deploy checklist for identity mapping changes.
kevin.ids: Filed ENGSEC-1830 for the contract test and ENGSEC-1831 for the KMS sanity check.
maria.ops: Thanks all — will update when full backfill completes. :thumbsup:
